result.instructions: Tools for Homebase, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Homebase data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run homebase_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run homebase_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run homebase_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. homebase_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: homebase_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The Homebase company this API key belongs to: name, owner (id, name, email, phone) and created/updated times. GET /company.

tools.name: homebase_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations (stores or sites) of the account with uuid, name, address, phone, website and time zone. The uuid is the id every other Homebase tool needs. GET /locations.

tools.name: homebase_get_location
tools.title: Get location
tools.description: One location by uuid: name, address, phone, website, time zone and POS merchant id. GET /locations/{location_uuid}.

tools.name: homebase_get_location_plan
tools.title: Get location plan
tools.description: The Homebase subscription plan of a location: plan number, price, last update and trial state. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/plan.

tools.name: homebase_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the employees of a location with contact details and their job: level, default role, additional roles, wage type and rate, payroll id and archive date. The time-clock PIN is never returned. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/employees.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homebase_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee of a location by user id, with contact details and job (role, wage type and rate, payroll id). The id is the job's user id from homebase_list_employees. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/employees/{id}.

employee_id.description: Homebase user id of the employee.

with_archived.description: Also find an archived employee (default false).

tools.name: homebase_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List the scheduled shifts of a location in a date range: employee, role, department, start and end, published/open state, wage rate and scheduled labor hours (regular, overtime). Filter open shifts only. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/shifts.

start_date.description: Start of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

end_date.description: End of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

open.description: Only open shifts that any employee can claim.

date_filter.description: Which shift time the range applies to (default start_at).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homebase_get_shift
tools.title: Get shift
tools.description: One shift of a location by id, with its labor data and optional note. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/shifts/{id}.

tools.name: homebase_list_deleted_shifts
tools.title: List deleted shifts
tools.description: The ids of shifts deleted in a date range at a location, with their start, end and deletion time. Use it to keep a copy of the schedule in sync. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/shifts/deleted.

start_date.description: Start of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

end_date.description: End of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homebase_list_timecards
tools.title: List timecards
tools.description: List the timecards (worked time) of a location in a date range: employee, role, clock in and out, breaks, hours, labor cost, tips and approval state. Time-off hours are always 0 on timecards; use homebase_get_labor_by_employee for totals with time off. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/timecards.

start_date.description: Start of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

end_date.description: End of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

date_filter.description: Which timecard time the range applies to (default clock_in).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homebase_get_timecard
tools.title: Get timecard
tools.description: One timecard of a location by id: clock in and out, breaks, labor hours and cost, tips, approval state. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/timecards/{id}.

tools.name: homebase_list_deleted_timecards
tools.title: List deleted timecards
tools.description: The ids of timecards deleted in a date range at a location, with clock in, clock out and deletion time. Use it to keep a copy of the timecards in sync. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/timecards/deleted.

start_date.description: Start of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

end_date.description: End of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homebase_get_labor
tools.title: Get labor report
tools.description: Aggregate labor for a location in a date range, grouped by day or by hour: regular, overtime and paid hours, labor cost, tips, breaks and time off. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/labor.

start_date.description: Start of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

end_date.description: End of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

group_by.description: Group the totals by day (default) or by hour.

tools.name: homebase_get_labor_by_role
tools.title: Get labor report by role
tools.description: Aggregate labor (hours, cost, tips, overtime) for a location in a date range, grouped by role. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/labor/by_role.

start_date.description: Start of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

end_date.description: End of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

tools.name: homebase_get_labor_by_employee
tools.title: Get labor report by employee
tools.description: Aggregate labor (hours, cost, wage rate, tips, overtime, time off) for a location in a date range, grouped by employee. Use it for payroll totals. GET /locations/{location_uuid}/labor/by_employee.

start_date.description: Start of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

end_date.description: End of the range. ISO 8601: a date (2026-10-01) or a date-time with timezone (2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00).

tools.name: homebase_get_timeclock_status
tools.title: Get time clock status
tools.description: The current time-clock state of one job (employee at a location): clocked_in, on_break or clocked_out, the current shift, the shifts that can be clocked into and the breaks that can be started. The job id is the `job.id` of an employee from homebase_list_employees. GET /timeclock/status.

job_id.description: Homebase job id (`job.id` on an employee).
